utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a pretty good turnout already. If you want, I can tell you what folks are bringing by later.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh? Are you sure it’s already that busy? Let me know what people are bringing, then.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ve seen folks dropping off tools, a stack of blankets, and some canned goods already. I’ll keep an eye out and tell you if I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll bring it up again and make sure the repair drive stays on everyone’s mind.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, good idea—thanks for keeping it on the radar.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll mention it again and keep nudging folks about it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’d start with the broken fence by the corner lot — that’s the one folks keep mentioning. Then maybe the porch step at Mrs. Bell’s place.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll put the fence first, then Mrs. Bell’s step.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is getting started soon. If you want, I can help spread the word quietly around the block.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey—that’d help a lot. I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Cleo. Just let me know what’s missing, and I’ll mention it to a few neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Faye—I'm thinking Saturday morning, maybe around 9, so folks can still make it before lunch.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 9 works for me—I can help spread the word around the school crowd.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good to me—what’s the plan for the repair drive, and when are we heading out?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m thinking we meet by the corner lot in about an hour, then head out together to drop off the repair stuff. If I’m a little late, just give me a nudge—I’ve got a habit of forgetting the time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: An hour works for me—I’ll meet you by the corner lot. I’ll give you a nudge if needed, and I’ll be ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—if you’re still organizing the repair drive, I can spread the word to the neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot—thank you. I just want to make sure we have the timing and pickup details clear before I tell anyone.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course—just send me the timing and pickup details, and I’ll pass them along to everyone right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard folks were organizing a repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Nell—thank you. Right now I’m collecting a list of items and any skills people can lend, so if you can spread the word or tell me what you’re happy to help with, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can spread the word around the block, and I’m happy to help with simple sorting or carrying things. Just let me know what you need next.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what needs fixing for the drive? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure — we’re focusing on the leaky faucet, the loose porch step, and that broken fence latch by the back gate.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. I’ve got the leaky faucet, the loose porch step, and the broken fence latch by the back gate.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks for organizing it, Dane. I’ll bring what I can and help where I’m able.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli — really appreciate it. I’ll see you there, probably a bit late as usual.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No worries, Dane. I’ll be there and get started whenever you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand — what tools or help do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Gus — do you have a wrench set and a screwdriver I can borrow?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got both you can borrow. I’ll bring them by in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep an eye on where the repair drive is happening and let folks know if it moves. Do you want me to track a specific location?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, that’d help—just keep me posted if it changes. I’m pretty busy, so a quick update is perfect.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’ll keep an eye on the repair drive location and send you a quick update if it changes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a few tools I can lend out for the repair drive. Just let me know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’ll let you know what’s needed once I hear the list.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Rey — just send the list my way when you get it, and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’m a bit worried about the logistics—how are we getting everything there, and who’s handling the drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good question — can you confirm who’s bringing the items and whether someone’s doing the drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help confirm the items, but I still need to know who’s actually bringing them and who can handle the drop-off. Once we’ve got that, I’ll feel a lot better about the plan.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I can help spread the word about the repair drive. Just let me know what details you want shared.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — please share that it’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community hall, and people can bring broken small appliances or bikes. I really appreciate your help!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course — I’ll pass along that it’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community hall, and folks can bring broken small appliances or bikes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a few supplies set aside for the repair drive—what do you still need, Dane?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo. I’m running late as usual, but I can still use any extra tape, a screwdriver, or spare nails if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got tape and some spare nails for you. I’ll check for a screwdriver too and set them aside.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s been getting a lot of attention already. I heard folks are still pitching in, so it’s looking hopeful.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s great to hear — I’m glad people are still helping out. I’ll keep an eye on the school schedule and see where I can fit in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Faye — that’d help a lot. If you hear anything about timing, let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in—just point me to what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — we’ve got a loose railing by the corner steps and a leaking faucet in the community room. If you can start with the railing, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll head to the corner steps and take a look at that railing first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help out with the repair drive. Just let me know what you need me to do.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks Sam. Could you help collect donations and sort them at the table this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course, I can do that this Saturday. Just point me to the table and I’ll start sorting donations.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive now—if you know anyone who needs help, send them my way. We should get a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn—I’ll pass it along if I hear of anyone who could use a hand.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Nell—I'll keep you posted if anything changes. Hope we can help a few folks out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of where everything’s headed for the repair drive. If you tell me the drop-off spot, I’ll note it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s use the community center parking lot again. It’s easy to find and works well for drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, I’ve got the community center parking lot down for the drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, are we still on for the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — yes, I think so, but can you remind me what time and where we’re meeting for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — we said 3 PM at the community center parking lot. Does that still work for you?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s picking up nicely—people seem willing to pitch in. I’m running a few errands later, so I’ll keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’s great to hear, Ira—thanks for keeping an ear out. I’ll try to check in later and see if they need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing—I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful while I’m out. Hopefully the repair drive keeps rolling along nicely.
